prompt:
The section file sections/social-feed-strip.liquid renders a strip of social posts. Each block is one post; the markup marks the first and last rendered post with the modifier classes social-feed__item--first and social-feed__item--last. Do NOT change the markup. Replace only the JSON inside the single {% schema %} block so that it is exactly this schema (same keys, values and array order):

Top-level keys:
- "name": "Social feed"
- "tag": "section"
- "class": "social-feed-section"
- "settings" (in this order):
  1. type "text", id "heading", label "Heading", default "Follow us"
  2. type "checkbox", id "show_follow", label "Show follow link", default true (boolean)
  3. type "url", id "follow_url", label "Follow link" (no default)
- "blocks": exactly one block type: type "post", name "Post", with settings (in this order):
  1. type "url", id "post_url", label "Post link" (no default)
  2. type "text", id "caption", label "Caption", default "New post"
- "max_blocks": 8 (number)
- "presets": one preset with name "Social feed" and "blocks" containing exactly three entries, each {"type": "post"} with no settings, so the first/last styling is visible in the editor preview.

No other keys may be present anywhere in the schema. Change only sections/social-feed-strip.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
